summary: Iterates a fixed-stride element array owned by the this object and calls the update routine sub_569C10 on every element. The element count is the dword at this+0x0 and the array base pointer is the dword at this+0x4. Elements are 580 bytes apart. The loop runs only when the count at this+0x0 is positive, and returns the count read back from this+0x0 after iteration.

operations.description: Read the element count from this[0] and seed the loop counter, plus base index for the element pointer starting at this[1].
Guard on this[0] > 0; a non-positive count skips the loop entirely.
do-while loop that runs while the iteration counter is below the count at this[0].
Call sub_569C10(this[1] + v5, a2) on each element, passing the caller-supplied double argument a2.
Advance the element offset by the fixed stride of 580 bytes each iteration.
Return the count re-read from this[0] after the loop (or the initial read when the loop never ran).
Called by WheelDataCopy (0x004414D0) to run the per-body update over the vehicle physics body array.

unresolved: Type and layout of the array at this+0x4 are caller-defined; the 580-byte stride is taken from the raw source.
Purpose of the caller-supplied double argument a2 passed through to sub_569C10 is unknown.
